entities.summary: Nanjing Agricultural University is a public university located in Nanjing, Jiangsu, China. It is affiliated with the Ministry of Education and co-sponsored by the Ministry of Education and the Jiangsu Provincial Government. The university is part of Project 211 and the Double First-Class Construction.
